tbesh_html:
1) to flow, pour out, pour, gush forth, spring, bubble up, ferment
1a) (Qal) to flow
1b)(Hiphil) to pour out, emit, cause to bubble, belch forth
1b1) to pour out
1b2) to cause to bubble, ferment
1b3) to pour forth, emit, belch forth

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).
